legenda: Statements in favor (Frank W. Harris) and against (Jim Clark), Ballot Measure No. 8, 1982.
nota: O cargo na fonte é 'Chairman' do Alaska Committee. Não identificar com outro Jim Clark sem prova (espelho).
narracao: Harris, the committee chair quoted earlier, called the figures inflated. Jim Clark, against the move, reminded voters of the bonds they turned down in 1978.

conferencia.prova: "Relocation need not and should not cost anything like the unrealistic, inflated estimates shown on the ballot measure."

"In 1978, the voters of the State passed the FRANK Initiative… In that same year, the voters turned down a $966,000,000 bond issue to relocate the Capital."; assinatura "—Jim Clark, Chairman, Alaska Committee"
